author: SchoolBuses
body:
Hello, My name is SchoolBuses in minecraft and the reason why I was banned was because I advertised on this server. I extremely regret this and hopefully you guys can give me a chance to unban me. I would like to be unbanned from this server because my friends play on this server, and I cant go on it since I have been banned. I wish that i could undo my actions so that way i would never have been banned from this server. 

-My ban was not false, I did go and advertise for another server but it was horrible, and i wish i have never done that.
-I do not have any evidence as i admit that i copy and pasted the server ip, where it did not succeed at all.
-I have waited a year to be unbanned, I was banned in 2014 October. 
-No i have not been caught ban evading and I did not ban evade once in my life. 
- Also,i have not appealed a ban before, this is my first time appealing a ban in this "New Discussion" section.
-Also, I wish that i could be unbanned from this server so that i could play with my friends and i truly wish that my actions would be forgiven
-

replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal, due to the fact that you waited a significant amount of time, and you seem sorry for what you have done.
If you are caught hacking again, your chances of being appealed will be very low.
Make sure to read the rules before joining the server again.
Welcome back!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
